title: Inkling-2-Mini
summary: Inkling-2-Mini on one RTX 5090 (32 GB) at TP=1 with gr8 and bundled DFlash speculative decoding: bit325 default (328.1 Code / 424.5 Math / 341.6 JSON / 201.1 Prose / 592.5 Counting tok/s, C=4 777.0 tok/s agg, 10,076 tok/s 4K prefill / 6,057 @ 128K, 8/8 exact DFlash greedy parity, 262K KV pool), k4 for higher quality / graduate-level science (274.4 Code / 438.5 Math / C=4 649.1 tok/s), and bit225 fast tier (354.4 Code / 768.3 C=4 / 528.1 C=6 thinking, 10,108 tok/s 4K prefill, 0.041282 KL).

configs.label: 1 GPU · bit325
configs.max_tokens_per_chat_note: 4 x 65,536 slabs (262K pool, 28.75 GiB @ PREFILL=4096); PROFILE=long fits 303K x 1

quality.name: DFlash K=7 vs MTP=0 greedy parity

configs.notes: bit325 experts (3.25 bpw, 16.43 GB device image) + bundled 279 MB DFlash drafter (MTP=7, auto-discovered). Measured 2026-11-26 on 1x RTX 5090 32 GB (sm_120a, gr8 PR #640 / main commit 2c221e98, GR8_INK2_PF_MX8_MOE=3, PREFILL=4096, GR8_INK2_MX8_DENSE=2, GR8_INK2_MX8_LM_HEAD=0; 4.01 s boot from NVMe). Layer-wise 1-slot (0.98 GiB) MXFP8 MoE prefill reaches 10,076 tok/s at 4K / 9,580 at 8K / 8,729 at 32K / 7,637 at 64K / 6,057 at 128K (+100.2% vs v1.3.1); 2-slot GR8_INK2_PF_MX8_MOE=4 reaches 10,396 tok/s at 4K. Single-stream 8-domain decode baselines measured 2026-11-25 (commit 6b874803) and re-verified on 2026-11-26 with 8/8 exact greedy parity + C=1/2/4 concurrency.

configs.label: 1 GPU · K4 quality
configs.notes: k4 experts (4.00 bpw, 18.72 GB device image) + bundled DFlash (MTP=7). Recommended for maximum quality and graduate-level science (GPQA). Set VARIANT=k4 (or PROFILE=k4) in .env (4 x 49,152 = 196K KV pool at PREFILL=4096, 28.83 GiB; or PROFILE=long with VARIANT=k4 for 229,376 x 1 at PREFILL=4096, 29.18 GiB). Decode and PREFILL=256 prefill baseline measured 2026-11-25 on 1x RTX 5090 32 GB (4.76 s boot from NVMe).

configs.label: 1 GPU · bit225 fast
configs.notes: bit225 fast preset (2.25 bpw, 13.37 GB device image, 0 extra weight bytes: 2,304 K2 + 768 loop-core K3 experts) + bundled DFlash (MTP=7) with speed flags (PROFILE=bit225-fast: GR8_INK2_MX8_DENSE=1, GR8_INK2_MX8_LM_HEAD=1, GR8_S2_ADAPT=1). Dedicated 32 GB RTX 5090 fits 4 x 81,920 = 327K KV pool in fast mode (28.58 GiB @ PREFILL=4096) or 4 x 90,112 = 360K in standard mode (VARIANT=bit225: 436.3 Math / 384.1 JSON / 604.8 Counting tok/s, 385K x 1 long). Prefill sweep measured 2026-11-26 at PREFILL=4096 GR8_INK2_PF_MX8_MOE=3 (k2, identical dense/attention/loop prefill path; 2-slot mode=4 reaches 10,454 tok/s @ 4K and 6,258 @ 128K).
